title.rendered: Weekly Devotional Roundup: April 26 to May 2, 2026

excerpt.rendered: This week’s Gospelbuzz morning devotionals, from Elijah at the Brook (1 Kings 19) to My Help Comes from the Lord (Psalm 121). Catch up on any you missed and get a preview of next week’s grace-centred series.

content.rendered:
Every morning at 6AM (UTC+8), Gospelbuzz publishes a daily devotional to help you start your day grounded in Scripture and rooted in grace. Here is a look back at this week’s seven devotionals, catch up on any you missed, or share one with someone who needs it today.

☀️ Sunday, April 26, When God Shows Up: Elijah at the Brook

Scripture: 1 Kings 19:5–7
God does not relate to you based on your last spiritual victory. He meets you where you are, exhausted, under the broom tree, and says: arise and eat. The journey continues, but not in your own strength.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Monday, April 27, Far More Abundantly

Scripture: Ephesians 3:20–21
Your imagination is the floor of what God intends, not the ceiling. The same power that raised Jesus from the dead is already at work within you. Raise your expectation.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Tuesday, April 28, My Grace Is Sufficient

Scripture: 2 Corinthians 12:9
God’s power is not hindered by your weakness, it is perfected in it. When you are weak, then you are strong. Not strong because the weakness went away, but because Christ’s power rests on you.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Wednesday, April 29, Close to the Brokenhearted

Scripture: Psalm 34:18
God’s nearness is not a reward for spiritual performance, it is His response to your need. The greater the need, the greater His nearness. If your heart is broken today, you are not far from God. You are close to Him.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Thursday, April 30, The Throne of Grace

Scripture: Hebrews 4:16
The veil tore. The throne of judgment became the throne of grace. Come boldly, not tentatively, not hoping you will be allowed in, but with the confidence of a child running to a father. The door is open.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Friday, May 1, He Goes Before You

Scripture: Deuteronomy 31:8
You are not walking into the unknown. You are walking into where God already is. He goes before you, He is with you, He will never leave you nor forsake you. Do not be afraid. Do not be discouraged.

📖 Read the full devotional →

☀️ Saturday, May 2, My Help Comes from the Lord

Scripture: Psalm 121:1–2
Not from the mountain. Not from the circumstances shifting. From the Lord, the Maker of heaven and earth. He does not sleep, He does not fail, He does not run short. Your help comes from the best possible source.

📖 Read the full devotional →

📅 Coming Up Next Week, May 3–9

  • Sun May 3, You Are the Righteousness of God (2 Corinthians 5:21)
  • Mon May 4, Rooted and Built Up in Him (Colossians 2:6–7)
  • Tue May 5, There Is Now No Condemnation (Romans 8:1)
  • Wed May 6, You Have the Mind of Christ (1 Corinthians 2:16)
  • Thu May 7, Greater Is He That Is in You (1 John 4:4)
  • Fri May 8, I Am the Vine, You Are the Branches (John 15:5)
  • Sat May 9, The Lord Is My Shepherd (Psalm 23:1)

New devotionals publish every morning at 6AM. Subscribe so you never miss one. 🙏
